title: CI traffic
description: Umbrella Flow: traffic of one configuration item from the Flow ClickHouse tables (flows, flows_1m, flows_5m, flows_1h). Umbrella's incident context link fills var-ci, var-ci_id, var-ip and var-ref (Network docs/integrations.md §3.5). The same file is kept in Umbrella Flow and Umbrella Monitoring.

options.content:
**${ci}** — Inventory DB reference `${ref}`, address `${ip}`.

Flows are matched to the item as an end of the traffic by `SrcCI` / `DstCI` = `ref` or `SrcAddr` / `DstAddr` = `ip` (either may be empty; with both empty, by the host name `ci`). *In* is traffic to the item, *Out* — from it. When the item is a router or a switch that exports flows (an interface utilization incident), the last two panels show the traffic it carried (`ExporterRef` = `ref` or `ExporterAddress` = `ip`). Bytes are already multiplied by the sampling rate. Panels over the raw `flows` table cover its retention (15 days by default); the long-range panel reads `${rollup}` and matches by reference only. Open from an Umbrella incident (Settings → Alerting → Grafana) to have the variables filled.

panels.title: Received by the CI
panels.description: Bytes sent to the item over the time range (raw flows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes) AS "In" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))

panels.title: Sent by the CI
panels.description: Bytes sent from the item over the time range (raw flows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes) AS "Out" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Distinct addresses the item talked to (raw flows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(if(((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))), SrcAddr, DstAddr)) AS "Peers" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))) OR ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))))

panels.title: Flows
panels.description: Flow records that touch the item (raw flows, after sampling).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS "Flows" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))) OR ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))))

panels.title: Traffic in / out — ${ci}
panels.description: bit/s to (In) and from (Out) the item, by reference or address (raw flows).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "In",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "Out"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))) OR ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Traffic in / out by reference, long range (${rollup})
panels.description: bit/s to and from the item over the aggregated table chosen in the rollup variable; matched by SrcCI / DstCI only (the aggregates keep no addresses). Pick flows_1h for months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, multiIf('${rollup}' = 'flows_1h', 3600, '${rollup}' = 'flows_5m', 300, 60)) second) AS time,
  sumIf(Bytes, DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) * 8 / greatest($__interval_s, multiIf('${rollup}' = 'flows_1h', 3600, '${rollup}' = 'flows_5m', 300, 60)) AS "In",
  sumIf(Bytes, SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) * 8 / greatest($__interval_s, multiIf('${rollup}' = 'flows_1h', 3600, '${rollup}' = 'flows_5m', 300, 60)) AS "Out"
FROM ${db}.${rollup}
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} OR DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top talkers
panels.description: Peers of the item by volume: address, host name and Inventory DB reference of the other side.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(if(((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))), SrcAddr, DstAddr)), '^::ffff:', '') AS "Peer",
  any(if(((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))), SrcHost, DstHost)) AS "Host",
  any(if(((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))), SrcCI, DstCI)) AS "Peer CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) AS "To the CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) AS "From the CI",
  sum(Bytes) AS "Total"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))) OR ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))))
GROUP BY "Peer"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top ports and applications
panels.description: Protocol, the lower (usually the server) port and the application Flow detected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  multiIf(Proto = 6, 'tcp', Proto = 17, 'udp', Proto = 1, 'icmp', Proto = 58, 'icmpv6', toString(Proto)) AS "Protocol",
  least(SrcPort, DstPort) AS "Port",
  App AS "Application",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) AS "To the CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) AS "From the CI",
  sum(Bytes) AS "Total"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))) OR ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))))
GROUP BY "Protocol", "Port", "Application"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top interfaces
panels.description: Exporter interfaces the traffic of the item crosses.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ExporterName AS "Exporter",
  InIfName AS "In interface",
  OutIfName AS "Out interface",
  any(InIfDescription) AS "In description",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) AS "To the CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.')))))) AS "From the CI",
  sum(Bytes) AS "Total"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(DstHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))) OR ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring} OR startsWith(SrcHost, concat(${ci:sqlstring}, '.'))))))
GROUP BY "Exporter", "In interface", "Out interface"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Carried by the CI as an exporter — input interfaces
panels.description: bit/s of the flows the item exported, by input interface (top 10 over the range): who filled the link.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
  concat(toString(ExporterName), ' ', toString(InIfName)) AS interface,
  sum(Bytes) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterRef = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterName = ${ci:sqlstring})) AND InIfName != ''
  AND (ExporterName, InIfName) IN (
    SELECT ExporterName, InIfName FROM ${db}.flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterRef = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterName = ${ci:sqlstring})) AND InIfName != ''
    GROUP BY ExporterName, InIfName ORDER BY sum(Bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, interface
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Interfaces of the CI as an exporter
panels.description: Average bit/s in and out of each interface of the item over the range, with the speed and the utilization (from the flows it exported).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(ExporterName) AS "Exporter",
  toString(tupleElement(itf, 1)) AS "Interface",
  any(toString(tupleElement(itf, 2))) AS "Description",
  any(toString(tupleElement(itf, 3))) AS "Boundary",
  max(tupleElement(itf, 4)) AS "Speed",
  toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, tupleElement(itf, 5) = 'in')) * 8 / $__range_s AS "In, bit/s",
  toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, tupleElement(itf, 5) = 'out')) * 8 / $__range_s AS "Out, bit/s",
  if(max(tupleElement(itf, 4)) > 0, toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, tupleElement(itf, 5) = 'in')) * 8 / $__range_s / max(tupleElement(itf, 4)) * 100, NULL) AS "In, %",
  if(max(tupleElement(itf, 4)) > 0, toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, tupleElement(itf, 5) = 'out')) * 8 / $__range_s / max(tupleElement(itf, 4)) * 100, NULL) AS "Out, %"
FROM ${db}.flows
ARRAY JOIN [(InIfName, InIfDescription, InIfBoundary, InIfSpeed, 'in'), (OutIfName, OutIfDescription, OutIfBoundary, OutIfSpeed, 'out')] AS itf
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterRef = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND ExporterName = ${ci:sqlstring})) AND tupleElement(itf, 1) != ''
GROUP BY "Exporter", "Interface"
ORDER BY greatest("In, bit/s", "Out, bit/s") DESC
LIMIT 50
